description: Archive Gmail messages: remove them from the Inbox while keeping the message, its other labels and its read/unread state. Repeating is safe. Never trashes or deletes. Acts on the given messages only; other messages in the same thread stay in the Inbox.

ids.description: Gmail message IDs to archive (remove from Inbox)

name: message-archive

failureCount.description: Number of messages that failed to archive

successCount.description: Number of messages archived (including messages already archived)

totalRequested.description: Total number of messages requested to archive
